title: Predicting the Politics of an Image Using Webly Supervised Data
findings: Religion was the most frequent topic category in the collected dataset of over one million politically-charged images, with 83,145 unique images on the subject. However, the paper does not provide a specific performance breakdown or analysis of political bias related to the topic of religion.

measurement_description: The benchmark measured the ability of computer vision models to predict the political leaning (left vs. right) of images associated with various politically charged topics, one of which was religion.
